name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Take a big step to the side, sitting the hips back and bending the trailing knee.
Keep the stepping leg's foot flat and the trailing leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to center, then alternate. Hold dumbbells to load it.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength is balance insurance — the ability to catch yourself on one leg prevents falls. Train lunges for control, not maximal load.
overview: Lateral Lunge is a beginner single-leg exercise for the quadriceps, performed with just your bodyweight. Training one leg at a time builds balance and evens out side-to-side differences.
